params.name: address
params.description: URL-encoded street address of the location

params.name: transit
params.description: Set to 1 to include Transit Score in the response

params.name: bike
params.description: Set to 1 to include Bike Score in the response

params.name: format
params.description: Response format. Defaults to XML if not specified

items.docs: Returns the Walk Score, Transit Score, and Bike Score for a given location specified by coordinates and address. Walk Score is returned for all requests. Transit Score and Bike Score are optional and must be explicitly requested. Scores range from 0 (car-dependent) to 100 (walker's/transit/biker's paradise). Calls must be made from server-side scripts. API is supported in the United States and Canada.
